Definition: a palanquin or canopy (as a fixture); also a species of lizard (probably as clinging fast)
BiblicalUsage: 1) a carrying vehicle, litter, covered wagon; 2) an unclean lizard; 2a) perhaps a tortoise; 2b) perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning unknown
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
